_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 29: 2025-10-09 to 2025-10-23. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that others believe a great economic crisis worse than 2008 is coming in the next year, and says he believes in a supernatural wealth transfer for the body of Christ before all of that starts.
mentions.quote: a great economic crisis worse than 2008
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis worse than 2008 within the year, preceded by a transfer of wealth to the church.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking to awaken is coming, that when people ask when he does not know, but that as of 23 September this was the point of no return and a great acceleration would begin after it, involving the fig tree and the nations.
mentions.quote: people say, When? I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable acceleration after 23 September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and he removes the date for the shaking itself.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes it is the fall of 2027 and is praying over that, tells people not to quote him, says he hears in part and sees in part, and that if he sees something and it does not come to pass he did his best and prayed into it.
mentions.quote: If I see something and it don't come to pass, I did my best
mentions.falsify_match: The stated standard for a miss: he did his best and prayed into it. Worth setting against false-prophecies-2020-admitted, where he holds others to a harder line.

mentions.claim_text: He guesses a film will come out in 2026, maybe the fall of 2026, says he does not know, but that it will be a major tool to bring in the lost and that the Lord said to pray for the man making it.
mentions.quote: when the movie will come out probably in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: The film releasing in 2026 and having a visible evangelistic effect.
mentions.falsify_miss: It slips or lands without effect.

mentions.claim_text: He says people may have money and fame but do not have God, and are empty, alone and lost, then prays healing over the bodies of the audience.
mentions.quote: They may have money. They may have fame, but they don't have you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is on the dryness, that they did not multiply the men, but that he hears the sound of a mighty rushing wind and a great sound of rain coming.
mentions.quote: sound of a mighty rushing wind. And there'll be a great sound of the rain
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion, and the dryness is pre-explained.

mentions.claim_text: He says they cannot wait until the fall of 2026 to start praying about this, that it must be tackled now, and that they must pray going into 2026 all the way until November when this time next year arrives.
mentions.quote: cannot wait until 2026 into the fall
mentions.falsify_match: The 2026 midterm outcome, which the prayer is aimed at.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that healing power flows from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, denouncing word curses, incantations, chants and voodoo.
mentions.quote: We denounce word curses, incantations, chants, voodoo
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge that hypothyroidism is being healed, that he just saw it for that person, and that their mind will start to feel clear after a heaviness.
mentions.quote: Hypo- hypothyroidism is being healed
mentions.falsify_match: A named condition, so a viewer could in principle report a verified remission.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported, and the condition is common enough that any large audience supplies matches.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will see some things but he is not going to participate in the drama, that the glory is on his household, and that as he is so are they in this world.
mentions.quote: I'm not going to participate in the drama
mentions.condition_text: the exemption rests on the glory being on the household
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the same household exemption as refuse-to-participate.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the 2026 elections that it be the largest and greatest red wave ever seen in the history of the country, and that the people not become lackadaisical.
mentions.quote: the largest and the greatest red wave we have ever seen
mentions.falsify_match: A historic Republican sweep in November 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that Asia, Africa, South America and Europe are all having revival with the greatest presence and outpouring, and prays a flood of glory over the nations.
mentions.quote: Asia is having revival. Africa is having revival. South America is having revival
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous revival movements reported on four continents.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such reports, though he states it as already happening.

mentions.claim_text: Answering people asking where the earthquakes are, he says they are coming, that they are only in the first part of October, and that great change is coming.
mentions.quote: People want to know where the earthquakes are. They're coming
mentions.falsify_match: A notable earthquake sequence following October 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note he is answering an audience already asking why a prediction has not landed.

mentions.claim_text: He says the video will be played thousands more times and believes somebody will get born again tonight, noting people are still getting saved on the recording.
mentions.quote: I know this video will be played thousands and thousands
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: unnamed conversions.

mentions.claim_text: He reads 1 Peter 4 on not thinking the fiery trial strange but rejoicing as partakers of Christ's sufferings so as to be glad when his glory is revealed.
mentions.quote: as though some strange thing happened unto you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture read straight.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is why he was shown a great shaking to awaken, and that the Lord now says it is no longer coming, it is here.
mentions.quote: No longer coming, it's here
mentions.falsify_match: The shaking declared present rather than future, which converts an unmet prediction into a current state.

mentions.claim_text: He says much work remains concerning the midterm elections and warns against thinking they will just steamroll it and have a red wave.
mentions.quote: If you think that we're just going to steamroll this and have a red wav
mentions.falsify_match: A close or losing midterm for Republicans.
mentions.falsify_miss: A sweep, which is what he prayed for two days later at JJiG596K_R0@2914.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the Holy Ghost pull draw those who cannot come unless drawn, and that blinders come off those blinded in the natural by darkness.
mentions.quote: unless he is drawn by him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are in times like never seen and that things will accelerate as labour pains, that he told them from 23 September to watch the victory, and that a great acceleration has happened so far.
mentions.quote: A great acceleration has happened so far
mentions.falsify_match: He scores his own September call as already landing, without naming what accelerated.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces another preacher's channel and says the Lord has put some things about October that are strategic concerning the glory and the outpouring, and that they are praying into it.
mentions.quote: he's put some things about October that is very uh strategic
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in August the Lord told him not to talk to the other man yet, that the other man had independently been told the same thing without knowing, and that they only spoke yesterday.
mentions.quote: don't talk to him yet. And he didn't know that the Lord had said that
mentions.falsify_match: A mutual confirmation story, checkable only against the other party's account.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw by the Spirit an escalation of things, and that in prayer yesterday the Lord told him he had warned him that a great something was coming.
mentions.quote: I saw by the spirit of God escalation of things
mentions.falsify_match: An escalation following mid October 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows what the Lord is showing him and that he saw he is dreaming of a white Christmas, with a great escalation of war alongside it.
mentions.quote: Christmas. And it was like it was with a with a great escalation of war
mentions.falsify_match: A war escalation around Christmas 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord told them when they hit 23 September that this was the point of no return, alongside an aside about buying a tea everybody recommended.
mentions.quote: we hit the 23rd of of September that that was the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: An irreversible turn dated to 23 September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He asks preachers whether they will squander it away, says it is time to preach repentance and holiness from the pulpits and tell people Christ is coming sooner than they think.
mentions.quote: he's coming sooner than you think
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.
